nodes.summary: Let $k$ be a commutative semiring and let $S$ be a commutative $k$-algebra. For a regular function $F$ from $k^\sigma$ to $k^\tau$ and a point $a \in S^\sigma$, the evaluation of $F$ at $a$ is the point $F(a) \in S^\tau$ whose $t$-th coordinate, for $t \in \tau$, is the value of the polynomial $F_t$ at $a$, obtained by substituting $a_s$ for $X_s$ for every $s \in \sigma$.
nodes.title: Evaluation of a regular function at a point

nodes.summary: Let $k$ be a commutative semiring and let $S$ be a commutative $k$-algebra. For regular functions $G$ from $k^\tau$ to $k^\iota$ and $F$ from $k^\sigma$ to $k^\tau$ and every point $a \in S^\sigma$, write $F(a) \in S^\tau$ for the evaluation of $F$ at $a$. Then evaluating the composition $G \circ F$ at $a$ gives $G(F(a))$, the evaluation of $G$ at the point $F(a)$.
nodes.title: Evaluation respects composition

nodes.summary: For regular functions $H$ from $k^\iota$ to $k^\kappa$, $G$ from $k^\tau$ to $k^\iota$ and $F$ from $k^\sigma$ to $k^\tau$, we have $(H \circ G) \circ F = H \circ (G \circ F)$.
nodes.title: Associativity of composition of regular functions

nodes.summary: For every regular function $F$ from $k^\sigma$ to $k^\tau$, composing $F$ with the identity regular function on $k^\sigma$, whose components are the variables $X_s$ for $s \in \sigma$, gives $F$, that is, $F \circ \mathrm{id} = F$.
nodes.title: The identity is a right unit for composition

nodes.summary: For regular functions $G$ from $k^\tau$ to $k^\iota$ and $F$ from $k^\sigma$ to $k^\tau$, the composition $G \circ F$ is the regular function from $k^\sigma$ to $k^\iota$ whose $i$-th component, for $i \in \iota$, is the polynomial obtained from $G_i$ by substituting $F_t$ for the variable $X_t$ for every $t \in \tau$.
nodes.title: Composition of regular functions

nodes.summary: For every regular function $F$ from $k^\sigma$ to $k^\tau$, composing the identity regular function on $k^\tau$, whose components are the variables $X_t$ for $t \in \tau$, with $F$ gives $F$, that is, $\mathrm{id} \circ F = F$.
nodes.title: The identity is a left unit for composition

nodes.summary: The Jacobian of a regular function $F = (F_j)_{j \in \tau}$ from $k^\sigma$ to $k^\tau$ is the $\tau \times \sigma$ matrix, with entries in the polynomial ring $k[X_i : i \in \sigma]$, whose entry in row $j$ and column $i$ is the formal partial derivative $\partial F_j / \partial X_i$.
nodes.title: Jacobian matrix of a regular function

nodes.summary: For a commutative semiring $k$ and index types $\sigma$ and $\tau$, a regular function from $k^\sigma$ to $k^\tau$ is a family $F = (F_t)_{t \in \tau}$ of polynomials in the variables $X_s$, $s \in \sigma$, with coefficients in $k$.
nodes.title: Regular functions

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
